supportingSources.label: Transcribed Whoa Nellie, Primus, and Pabst rules walkthrough
Exact-machine Pabst Can Crusher tournament finals

strategy.overview: Use the top lanes to light their same-color pop bumpers and star rollovers, then shoot the hole to collect the lit bumper values. Lighting all four bumpers qualifies Crushing Time at the hole.
strategy.simpleOverview: Send the ball through all four colored top lanes to light their matching bumpers, then shoot the hole to collect their values and start Crushing Time.
strategy.summary: Send the ball through the top lanes to light their matching pop bumpers and star rollovers. Shoot the hole to collect the lit bumper values; after all four bumpers are lit, the hole starts Crushing Time.

quickInfo.name: Skill Shot
quickInfo.summary: Soft-plunge the shooter-lane hole for 50 points, or 200 when it is flashing.

quickInfo.name: Light the colors
quickInfo.summary: Each top lane lights the same-color pop bumper and star rollover, raising those features to 10 points.

quickInfo.name: Hole collect
quickInfo.summary: The hole scores 50 points, or 200 when lit, and also collects the values of the lit bumpers.

quickInfo.name: Crushing Time
quickInfo.summary: Send the ball through each colored top lane to light all four bumpers, then shoot the hole to start Crushing Time.

steps.text: Soft-plunge the shooter-lane hole for the Skill Shot. It scores 50 points, or 200 when flashing.
Send the ball through different top lanes. Each lane lights the same-color pop bumper and star rollover for 10-point hits.
Watch which bull's-eye is lit for 200. Any 5- or 50-point hit rotates that lit 200-point shot.
Shoot the hole for 50 points, or 200 when lit, and to collect the current values of the lit bumpers.
After all four pop bumpers are lit, shoot the hole to start Crushing Time.

cautions.issue: The explanatory video uses a licensed digital recreation of the shared layout.
cautions.response: These mechanics apply to the exact Pabst machine; copy-specific feeds and settings can still differ.
